terms.explanationEnDraft: Legal help under an applicable legal-aid scheme; eligibility and services depend on the scheme.
The legal power of a particular body to handle a particular matter.
The person bringing a claim; terminology differs between proceedings.
The party responding to an application or appeal; use the term prescribed by that proceeding.
A responding party in civil proceedings or an accused person in criminal proceedings; these roles must be distinguished.
A formal document requiring a response or attendance; inspect the actual document and service.
Delivering documents in the manner required by the applicable rules.
A proceeding at which the relevant body hears the matter.
A court decision; its reasons, orders and available challenges must be read together.
A direction or decision made by a competent body.
A formal expression of a civil adjudication as defined by the applicable law; do not equate every order with a decree.
A challenge to a decision before an appellate body, subject to applicable conditions.

terms.kiswahiliDraft: Mapitio ya mamlaka ya juu — kuthibitishwa
terms.explanationEnDraft: Supervisory examination under the applicable law; distinguish it from review by the deciding court.
Reconsideration under the applicable rules; distinguish it from an appeal or supervisory revision.

terms.kiswahiliDraft: Muda wa ukomo wa kuleta shauri
terms.explanationEnDraft: A legal time limit whose trigger, exceptions and extension rules require issue-specific checking.
Permission to take a step after the usual time, where the applicable law allows it.
A temporary suspension ordered under applicable law; filing an appeal does not automatically establish a stay.
An order concerning doing or refraining from specified acts; conditions depend on the proceeding.
A written statement sworn or affirmed in a legally recognised manner.
A person providing evidence; safety and procedural requirements need separate consideration.
Agreement to a specified action; validity and required form depend on the action and person involved.
Restrictions on sharing information; do not promise absolute secrecy without an approved policy and legal basis.
A handoff to a service provider; distinguish this service referral from a court appeal.
A facilitated attempt to reach agreement; suitability, voluntariness and safety must be assessed.

terms.kiswahiliDraft: Uamuzi wa mgogoro kwa usuluhishi wa kisheria — kuthibitishwa
terms.explanationEnDraft: An adjudicative dispute process under an agreement or law; distinguish it from facilitated mediation.
A legal process or grant relating to a will under the applicable succession law.
A person appointed under the applicable law to administer an estate; family nomination alone must not be assumed to confer authority.
A person entitled or potentially entitled under a scheme, estate or instrument; entitlement needs verification.

terms.kiswahiliDraft: Msamaha au upunguzaji wa ada — kuthibitishwa
terms.explanationEnDraft: Relief from a fee under the applicable rules; eligibility and procedure must be checked.
An accessibility adjustment whose legal definition and duties depend on the applicable disability law.
When legal provisions come into operation; assent, publication and appointed dates may differ.

terms.kiswahiliDraft: Kufutwa kwa sheria na masharti ya kuendeleza mambo yaliyotangulia
terms.explanationEnDraft: Provisions ending an earlier law while addressing some existing rights, actions or proceedings.
